column1: # remote-runner fixture: fetch-and-run launchers, red. Every row below is mapped,
# named and diff-scoped, so the only thing under test is how the command reaches its
# binary. The launcher is compared by basename, so path-qualifying it buys nothing, and
# a long spelling is refused with the alias it expands. Rows 1, 5 and 6 must pass (two
# repo-local paths, one an absolute CI checkout; an explicit --no-install pin), so the
# rule discriminates rather than rejecting every path or every JS command.
